capabilities: Mix four audio channels with faders, mute and live VU meters
Trigger looping beds and one-shots from 12-pad loadouts
Stage and switch scenes with smooth or sudden crossfades
Frame vault images and videos with pan, zoom and rotate
Stream framed battlemaps to a Raspberry Pi driving an HDMI display
extras: The Battlemap tab is hidden in the current release (re-enable via BATTLEMAP_ENABLED in src/view/ConsoleView.ts). Mobile audio pauses when Obsidian is backgrounded due to webview throttling; VU meters are inactive on mobile. The Pi agent, systemd units and protocol details live in the repo (pi-agent/).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tool for running ambience, music and one-shot effects during tabletop sessions, or for pushing a battlemap to a second screen.

relations.evidence: The agent converts the plugin's intuitive wire units to mpv: video-zoom = log2(scale)

requires.name: Raspberry Pi running the bundled DnDJay agent (mpv, systemd services)

summary: Tabletop session console with a 4-channel Web Audio soundboard, scene switching, loadouts, and a battlemap tab that streams framed maps to a Raspberry Pi display.
